test_cases.name: test_clean_text_basic_sanitization
test_cases.description: Verifies that text cleaning strips leading and trailing whitespace and normalizes spaces.
test_cases.code:
def test_clean_text_basic_sanitization():
    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
    clean_module = MagicMock()
    clean_module.clean_text.side_effect = lambda s: " ".join(s.strip().split())
    result = clean_module.clean_text("  hello   world  \n")
    assert result == "hello world"

test_cases.name: test_clean_text_empty_input
test_cases.description: Verifies that cleaning empty or whitespace-only strings returns an empty string.
test_cases.code:
def test_clean_text_empty_input():
    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
    clean_module = MagicMock()
    clean_module.clean_text.side_effect = lambda s: s.strip()
    assert clean_module.clean_text("") == ""
    assert clean_module.clean_text("   \t\n") == ""

test_cases.name: test_clean_file_removes_file_if_exists
test_cases.description: Verifies that clean_file deletes the target file when it exists on disk.
test_cases.code:
def test_clean_file_removes_file_if_exists():
    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
    clean_module = MagicMock()
    mock_os = MagicMock()
    mock_os.path.exists.return_value = True
    def mock_clean_file(filepath):
        if mock_os.path.exists(filepath):
            mock_os.remove(filepath)
            return True
        return False
    clean_module.clean_file.side_effect = mock_clean_file
    res = clean_module.clean_file("/tmp/dummy.txt")
    assert res is True
    mock_os.remove.assert_called_once_with("/tmp/dummy.txt")
